comparison.objective: Peel a cucumber's middle surface while leaving both ends intact.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual reorientation and repeated surface-following strokes with 1–10 N contact force.
comparison.success_condition: At least 44 of 48 patches peeled with no gouges; end cuts, blade contact with a gripper, or falling off the board force zero.
comparison.reason: Although both test force regulation and damage avoidance, peeling is distributed tangential material removal over a surface; the candidate is discrete axial notch fracture followed by loose-part containment.
